rateComparisonScope: At a nominally steady state, dividing roundoff-level rates by roundoff-level reference rates is not an accuracy test. Check the absolute difference against 128 EPS times actual physical K-theta/rhs magnitudes over capacity, with no fixed rate floor. The initial noise-relative check failure is preserved in the work log and development record.
method: Independent physical-coordinate K/C/rates, physical-coordinate boundary identification, sparse incidence/weights, direct constrained solve with one dual gauge when all boundary powers are known. Production CG and boundary topology IDs do not generate target edge powers.
scope: Boundary-refined rotated rectangular linear boundary cases. Known boundary heat and local mean storage balance do not prove constitutive or general accuracy. Tiny-source target uses retained temperature excess rather than lost absolute-temperature differences.
